# Tax calendar for freelancers (example country)

The quarterly VAT return is due on the sixteenth day of the second month after each quarter.
The yearly income declaration must be filed by the thirtieth of September. Advance payments are
paid in two instalments: forty percent in June and sixty percent in November.

## Penalties

Paying late within thirty days costs a reduced penalty of one point five percent plus legal
interest per day of delay.
